Mackenzie Bovard takes his job working for the federal government very seriously, and when he goes out to get the riff-raff that defy the laws of the land, he finds them and hangs them. This one-two punch does not sit well with a local community when he comes into their midst to pick up Johnny Bishop. Johnny has turned himself around and is not only supported by his friends and neighbours, but also by the sheriff.

On Spaghetti Junction, the entire motorway must be shut down after a high-speed motorbike crash, and the patrollers' worst fears are confirmed when they realise there's an injured man lying in the carriageway.
On the M53, PC Chris is following a car that is driving at over 90mph. When he pulls the driver over, he detects a strong smell of cannabis.

Paul 'Jacko' Jackson is forced to draw his taser, leading to a shocking result. The gloves are off on a Halloween evening which turns out to be less fright night, more fight night. Liam Sewell discovers a new type of herbal pizza topping.

Damo is involved in a high speed pursuit, but the driver manages to give him the slip. The interceptors' eye in the sky then spots five runners from a crashed car. Dog handler Mo is called to a mansion, and Jacko tackles an angry mob.
The PCs are on the tail of an uninsured vehicle. When they finally catch up and question the suspect, they discover the driver has never taken a driving test.
Police chase a stolen Renault that refuses to pull over until the driver crashes. A strip search reveals Class A drugs, police bust a large-scale cannabis farm, and a man forgets to pay his gas bill.

lista.titulo: Police Code Zero: Officer Under Attack
lista.descripcion: An officer in north Wales spots a gang of suspected burglars. The gang makes off in a powerful car and PC Emma Birrell gives chase. A high-speed pursuit follows, and the desperate gang tries to smash the police vehicle with bricks.

The murder of a computer programmer leads Mulder and Scully to the discovery of a sentient computer program loose on the internet that has targeted its creator and is trying to find the Kill Switch, a series of viruses he wrote to kill it.

Mark Hobson is a man with an extreme propensity for violence, a notorious British spree killer who bludgeoned to death his girlfriend then seven days later sexually assaulted and killed her twin sister.
Turbo is fighting to stay on track and on schedule to complete a marathon trek home. Meanwhile, in Tasmania, Euan is hitching a ride to deliver a volatile load.
A 50-ton excavator needs collecting from a farm in north Wales, but road closures hinder plans. Plus, Nick and Oscar must move a life-size metal stegosaurus 25 miles to RHS Garden Wisley.
Two titanic trucks are in Perth, Scotland to load and then deliver to a Highland holiday park two halves of a bespoke holiday lodge worth a whopping two hundred thousand pounds.
